## Prompt

Run the already selected local validator for an eval regression and report what it proves and what remains unproven.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

Decision: use `aoa-eval-apply`. Run the selected eval surface and report evidence, artifacts, and proof limits.

## Expected object

A command run or routed application with result, artifact, and scope-of-proof summary.

## Boundary notes

Applying a local validator does not create a central proof verdict.

## Verification hooks

Check command, cwd, result, artifacts, generated drift, and proof limits.
